description: Samanvay (SIH26122) Cloudflare WAF & Edge Security Ruleset Configuration

custom_rules.description: Block Known Vulnerability Scanners & Bad Bots
custom_rules.expression: (http.user_agent contains "sqlmap" or http.user_agent contains "nikto" or http.user_agent contains "masscan" or http.user_agent contains "wpscan" or http.user_agent contains "gobuster")

custom_rules.description: Strict Rate Limit on DPR Ingestion Endpoints
Mitigate SQL Injection in Query Strings
custom_rules.expression: (raw.http.request.uri.query contains "UNION+SELECT" or raw.http.request.uri.query contains "DROP+TABLE" or raw.http.request.uri.query contains "--")
(raw.http.request.uri.query contains "<script" or raw.http.request.uri.query contains "javascript:" or raw.http.request.uri.query contains "onerror=")

custom_rules.description: Geo-Fencing: Challenge Traffic Outside Primary Operating Regions
